decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the established and well-liked BASIC 518 trommel, which makes it a core screening product that the firm would keep offering.
The mobile flail shredder line fits squarely into the firm's mobile recycling portfolio and has had several years to establish itself.
The firm already cut the overlapping green-waste grinder in 2019, so this remaining high-speed grinder line likely carries the segment and should stay, though its low visibility leaves some risk.

Dropping the stationary pre-shredders in 2019 suggests the stationary segment is being trimmed, but the electric fine shredder serves rising demand for electric drives and plant solutions, so it is kept for now.
